goal: Resolve the Task reviewer through explicit reviewer, project template role slot, then node owner while preserving current authorization and atomic Task semantics.
expectedScope: Memory and SQLite parity only if new durable state is required
security, idempotency, concurrency and restart tests
nonGoals: UI or public role-binding administration API
new Membership, Grant or ACL capabilities
U7, U8 or nested security domains
acceptanceCriteria: Task creation accepts an optional reviewerRoleSlotKey that explicitly identifies the intended project slot
when multiple slot candidates are eligible, the canonical smallest Principal ID is selected deterministically
missing or ineligible slot candidates fall through to the current node owner
a final missing or ineligible candidate rejects atomically with REVIEWER_REQUIRED
every selected reviewer is revalidated against active principal, active project membership and the target object's current security-domain access
idempotent replay, migration behavior, CAS and transaction boundaries remain fail-closed
targeted and full mechanical gates pass
independent Codex R2 review passes before commit
nextAction: Commit and push the accepted worktree, then select the next Ready Task.
